record.specifics:
Remind auto-detects its lexical search backend at store init with no configuration: SQLite FTS5 (probed by trying to create a virtual table in an in-memory database, since not every Python SQLite build compiles FTS5 in), PostgreSQL tsvector (a STORED generated column plus a GIN index), or MySQL FULLTEXT. If none is available the lexical arm is simply skipped and recall falls back to pure vector search.
Remind 0.13.0 retrieval config defaults: lexical_enabled is true, rrf_k is 60, hybrid_keyword_weight is 0.3, and the three recall budget knobs recall_max_chars, recall_min_score and recall_timeout_ms all default to None, meaning disabled unless set per call.
